title: eludite.file.read output
description: The lines read, each prefixed with its 1-based number and a tab.

text.description: The lines, each as `<number>\t<text>`, joined by line feeds.

endLine.description: The last line returned (1-based; `startLine - 1` when none).

truncated.description: True when the 2,000-line or 256 KB cap stopped the read before `endLine` or the end of the file.

nextLine.description: With `truncated`: the line to pass as `startLine` to read on.

source.description: `buffer`: the open document's text, unsaved changes included; `disk`: the file on disk.

outsideWorkspace.description: True when the path is outside the workspace folder (or no workspace is open).
